definitions.explanation: A playing piece used in mahjong. A standard set contains 136 tiles divided into suits (萬子, 筒子, 索子) and honor tiles (字牌). Also written as 牌 in other tile-based games.

examples.japanese: {牌|ぱい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{混|ま}ぜて→混ぜる：02423_mazeru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{配|くば}る→配る：03921_kubaru⟧。
examples.english: Shuffle the tiles and then deal them.

examples.japanese: {手|て}{牌|ぱい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{不要|ふよう}→不要：02527_fuyou⟧な{牌|ぱい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}んで→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧⟦{捨|す}てる→捨てる：00892_suteru⟧。
examples.english: Choose an unnecessary tile from your hand and discard it.

notes: In mahjong terminology, {牌|ぱい} appears in many compounds: ⟦{手牌|てはい}→手牌：29933_tehai⟧ (tiles in one's hand), {字牌|じはい}/つーぱい (honor tiles), {萬子|まんず}/{筒子|ぴんず}/{索子|そーず} (the three number suits). Key verbs used with tiles: {牌|ぱい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{切|き}る→切る：02693_kiru⟧ (to discard), {牌|ぱい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}く→引く：01978_hiku⟧ (to draw), {牌|ぱい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{鳴|な}く→鳴く：04388_naku⟧ (to call a discarded tile). Mahjong is extremely popular in Japan both as a social game and as a subject of manga and anime.
